outcome: Risk of primary or secondary cesarean section
cohort: A non-selected singleton cohort of women from Lower Saxony, Germany
finding: Increasing parity was positively correlated with increased maternal BMI and a higher incidence of obesity-related complications during pregnancy, including diabetes, hypertension, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Obese women, particularly those in their first pregnancy, had an increased risk of primary or secondary cesarean section.
